test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the synonym of Perfunctory.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Careless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Perfunctory"** refers to an action carried out with minimal effort, interest, or reflection. It is something done as a routine or duty without genuine attention or enthusiasm. (उदासीन, जल्दी-जल्दी किया गया)

 
 
• **Example:** His perfunctory response to her heartfelt question showed his lack of interest.
 
 
 
• **"Careless"** means showing a lack of care, attention, or thoroughness in doing something. It is often associated with negligence or a casual attitude. (लापरवाह)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The careless handling of the documents resulted in their loss.
 
 
 
• Thus, we can understand that "Perfunctory" is synonymous with "Careless."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Careless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Diligent** (मेहनती): Showing care and effort in one's work or duties.
 
 
 
• **Example:** She is diligent in her studies and always achieves high grades.
 
 
 
 
• **Painstaking** (परिश्रमी): Done with great care and thoroughness.
 
 
 
• **Example:** The artist spent months on the painstaking details of the painting.
 
 
 
 
• **Detailed** (विस्तृत): Marked by careful attention to detail.
 
 
 
• **Example:** He provided a detailed explanation of the project requirements.
 
 

14d:T575,

The correct answer is **option 2.**
